```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

fmutils has three groups of helpers. `co_box()` and `status()` write Quarto callouts, and `%nin%` is a negated `%in%`. These stand alone and call no other fmutils functions. The font loaders and the ggplot2 theme call each other, so this article shows how they connect.

The trees below come from [`stackcallr`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/stackcallr/). `call_tree_dir()` parses the files in `R/` without running them. `include_ns` adds the calls into `extrafont`, `sysfonts`, and `showtext`.

## Call stack

### load_fm_fonts()

`load_fm_fonts()` registers the bundled Ubuntu fonts with `sysfonts` and turns on `showtext`.

```{r}
#| label: call-stack-load-fm-fonts
#| eval: !expr requireNamespace("stackcallr", quietly = TRUE)
#| collapse: false
#| comment: ""
stackcallr::call_tree_dir("../R",
  root = "load_fm_fonts",
  include_ns = c("extrafont", "sysfonts", "showtext")
)
```

### load_fmggp2_fonts()

`load_fmggp2_fonts()` checks for the fonts with `check_fonts()`. If they are missing, it imports them with `extrafont` and adds the regular Ubuntu face.

```{r}
#| label: call-stack-load-fmggp2-fonts
#| eval: !expr requireNamespace("stackcallr", quietly = TRUE)
#| collapse: false
#| comment: ""
stackcallr::call_tree_dir("../R",
  root = "load_fmggp2_fonts",
  include_ns = c("extrafont", "sysfonts", "showtext")
)
```

### theme_fmggp2()

`theme_fmggp2()` imports the fonts every time it runs, then builds the `ggplot2` theme.

```{r}
#| label: call-stack-theme-fmggp2
#| eval: !expr requireNamespace("stackcallr", quietly = TRUE)
#| collapse: false
#| comment: ""
stackcallr::call_tree_dir("../R",
  root = "theme_fmggp2",
  include_ns = c("extrafont", "sysfonts", "showtext")
)
```
